name: s2c-web-play
description: S2C Web Play — browser Go2 touchdown game. The repo root IS the site: plain ES modules, no bundler, no runtime dependencies, all paths relative.
//: There are no dependencies and there must not be any: MuJoCo is vendored under vendor/mujoco (see vendor/mujoco/VERSION.md). `npm install` is never needed to run or to deploy this site.
